The Cavaliers defeated the Pacers, 128-119 tonight in Cleveland. James Harden finished with a team-high 51 points along with 7 three pointers and 6 rebounds for the Cavaliers, while Donovan Mitchell tallied 20 points, 3 rebounds and 3 assists in the game. Pascal Siakam recorded 21 points, 7 rebounds and 2 assists. The Cavaliers improve their record to 9-8 with the win, while the Pacers fall to 5-11 for the season.
